fullDescription: A dark teal-black frosted-glass footer with an aqua aurora crest at the seam, a 4-column link grid, brand block, newsletter band, and a status-pill legal bar.
prompt: {"style": "Palette is deep teal-black: page base #04080d to #061319 (vertical gradient), glass panel rgba(12,28,34,0.78) fading to rgba(4,10,14,0.92). Accent is an aqua-to-cyan family: aqua #2ee6d6, aqua-soft #5ff3e6, cyan #21c8e8, used for the aurora glow, hairline, gradient text and the primary button (135deg linear-gradient #5ff3e6 to #21c8e8 with dark #032027 label text). Text is slate: headings #dff7f4 and slate-50, body slate-400, legal links slate-300 #cbd5e1 for WCAG contrast on the darkest band. Fonts via Google Fonts: Space Grotesk (display, weights 400-700) for the wordmark, column titles and buttons; Inter (body, 400-600). Mood is premium, frosted, luminous-on-dark with a faint 56px aqua grid texture masked at the top of the glass. Accents stay aqua-cyan only, never indigo or violet.", "summary": "Build a frameless full-bleed website footer on a deep teal-black page with a frosted-glass panel, an aqua aurora light crest glowing at the page-to-footer seam, a brand block, four link columns, a newsletter band, and a legal bar with a status pill.", "special_notes": "Frameless: render the footer section only, full-bleed, no mockup frame, browser bar or device shell. Edge details: the aurora and hairline must read as a glowing seam, not a hard border. All text must stay WCAG-legible on the dark glass (legal links use slate-300 #cbd5e1 for higher contrast on the lowest band). Use the aqua/cyan accent family only; avoid generic indigo or violet AI slop. No em-dashes in any copy.", "layout_and_structure": "Frameless full-width footer, no browser or device chrome, content centered in a max-w-7xl container with px-6. A 1px aqua top hairline (rgba(95,243,230,0.16)) plus an aurora crest (radial aqua/cyan glow, blurred ~34px, with a bright 2px gradient light-line and shadow) sits exactly at the seam between the page section above and the footer. Top region is a 12-column grid: brand block spans 4 columns (logo tile, wordmark, one-line description, social row), link columns span the remaining 8. Desktop shows 4 link columns (Product, Resources, Company, Community); tablet collapses them to a 2-column grid; mobile hides the grid entirely and shows native details/summary accordions with a rotating caret and divider hairlines. Below the columns: a rounded newsletter band, then a legal bar separated by a top hairline. Legal bar is centered and stacked on mobile, row-spaced-between on desktop.", "special_ui_components": ["Brand logo tile: rounded-xl aqua-to-cyan gradient square with a wave-sine glyph and an aqua glow ring. Social row: four square chip icon buttons (X, GitHub, Discord, YouTube) with aqua hover borders. Newsletter band: rounded-2xl chip card with heading, subcopy, an email input with a left envelope icon and an aqua focus ring, plus a gradient aqua Subscribe button. Legal bar: copyright, Privacy/Terms/Security links, and a status pill (pulsing emerald dot with glow + 'All systems normal'). Column-title eyebrows are uppercase, letter-spaced, 11px. Mobile uses accordion disclosure for each link group."]}
